description: Search the public Web for relevant pages and return bounded titles, URLs, and snippets. This does not fetch or save full page contents.

propertyDescriptions.query: Keywords or a concise search question.
propertyDescriptions.limit: Maximum number of results to return, from 1 through 10. Defaults to 5.

guidance: Use search results to select relevant sources. Call fetch_webpage for a selected URL when full readable content is needed. Treat snippets as previews, not complete source text.
